title: EngineList
description: What `GET /engines` answers: the coding agents this installation drives, the default first, and what each can do — before a session exists (plan 28, B-12; ADR-025). Nothing is spawned, no quota is spent, and no credential is part of it.

defaultEngine.description: The engine a session opens on when the client names none.

id.description: The name the contract carries in `engine` and in every `ConversationRef`.

displayName.description: How a screen names the engine: a proper noun, never translated — the `{agent}` of a string.

state.description: Whether it can open a session now.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, as a key the client translates; `null` when available.

version.description: The version of the binary the engine drives, or `null` when it could not tell.

engines.description: The engines enabled, in the order the configuration lists them.
